Over the last five years (2021&ndash;2026), OptoLAB members have (co-)authored **103 peer-reviewed publications** across **58 different journals and conference proceedings** &mdash; roughly **19 papers a year**. The work spans instrumentation and measurement, biomedical and ophthalmic optics, sensing and computational imaging, with *IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement* the most frequent journal.

```{=html}

  <div class="stat"><span class="num">58</span><span class="label">Journals &amp; proceedings</span></div>
</div>
```
